_comment: Default hooks for Кира. Edit and webchat will pick up changes (mtime-cached). See agent_hooks.py docstring for format.

hooks._comment: Self-edit guard: deny edits to the security-critical core of webchat. Auth, key pool, hook config, sandbox runner, the restart token, and the critic itself MUST NOT be silently rewritten by the agent in-flight. To intentionally change them, edit on the host outside the agent, or disable this hook in hooks.json first.

action.message: self-edit of security-critical file is blocked by hook deny-self-edit-core; edit on the host or disable this hook first

hooks._comment: Audit-log every other write into /host/webchat/* so self-edits are visible in /agent/actions. Pairs with deny-self-edit-core above.
Shell redirect bypass — block redirecting into security-critical files via execute_bash even though fs_write is already guarded above.

action.message: shell redirect into security-critical webchat file is blocked
